title: SwarmKit Delegation Envelope
description: Orchestrator → specialist delegation envelope per spec §7.2. JSON wire format over A2A JSON-RPC 2.0 channel after the orchestrator has decrypted the SwarmKit and provisioned the specialist agent. MAY itself be TDF-wrapped if the transport is untrusted. The delegation_signature is computed over the JCS-canonical form of the envelope with the signing block excluded.

skills.description: Full skill bodies, individually signed (§7.3). Specialist MUST verify each signature.

items.description: Reference to an input — typically a content hash, TDF locator, or iroh ticket

peer_roles.description: Roles this specialist may talk to over A2A

delegation_signature.description: Orchestrator signature over the canonicalized delegation envelope, excluding the signing block itself

McpGrant.description: Concrete grant issued by the orchestrator to the specialist (§7.2). bearer_token / expires are present when the manifest's auth mode is 'delegated'; absent for 'passthrough' (specialist uses own creds) or 'none' (public servers).

bearer_token.description: Opaque token bound to the flight ID. Specialist MUST NOT cache beyond `expires` (§8.2)
